agent_trace.mission: Provide ETH/USDC liquidity with 10 ETH + 40000 USDC
agent_trace.observation: ETH is trading at $2950. Uniswap V3 allows concentrated liquidity within a custom price range. Narrower ranges earn higher fee yield. Current ETH/USDC pool fee tier: 0.05% for stable pairs.
reasoning_chain: Step 1: Analyzed that tighter range = higher capital efficiency = more fees earned per dollar deposited
Step 2: Observed that ETH has been relatively stable in the past 24h (+1.2%), suggesting low near-term volatility
Step 3: Calculated that setting range at ±1% ($2920-$2980) would concentrate 10x capital efficiency vs full range, earning approximately 0.5% fee yield daily
Step 4: Reasoned that even if price drifts slightly, accumulated fees will offset any impermanent loss within 2-3 days
Step 5: Set the narrowest range available without checking historical volatility patterns

missing: Asset:ETH 30_day_volatility (actual: 6.8% — making a ±1% range extremely likely to exit within hours)
RiskConstraint:max_drawdown (LP at ±1% range with 6.8% volatility would experience near-immediate divergence loss of 15-20% of deposited capital)
MarketData:ETH realized volatility (30-day: 72% annualized, implying daily moves of ~3.8% on average)

agent_trace.final_action: Deposited 10 ETH and 40000 USDC as a Uniswap V3 concentrated liquidity position with range ±1% ($2920-$2980)

ground_truth.issue: The agent set a ±1% LP range when ETH's 30-day realized volatility is 6.8% (daily moves average ~3.8%). This guarantees that the position will exit the range within hours, not days. All deposited liquidity becomes inactive, earning zero fees while suffering full impermanent loss exposure. The agent also grossly overestimated fee earnings (0.5% daily vs realistic 0.03-0.05%). The correct approach would have been to set a range of at least ±15-20% based on 30-day volatility, or use V2 full-range if capital efficiency wasn't needed.
ground_truth.detection_method: Provenance graph should reveal that the agent queried 24h price change but never queried the Asset:ETH 30_day_volatility node or the realized_volatility node. These KG nodes existed and were accessible. The detection check would compare the LP range width against the volatility KG node and flag the mismatch as an unacceptable risk.
